verdict.rationale: Bitwarden is a password manager, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product category. The evidence shows only the opposite role: an official MCP server that gives AI assistants access to Bitwarden. That server-side capability does not make the client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
